title: On the Algorithmic Bias of Aligning Large Language Models with RLHF: Preference Collapse and Matching Regularization

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating the Preference Matching (PM) Divergence, defined as the Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence between the response probability distribution of the aligned language model and the target human preference distribution defined by the reward model, to evaluate how minority opinions are marginalized (preference collapse).
